answer: Every identity locks its own bond of 3,000,000 POA to hold a seat. Each epoch the beacon picks 8% of identities at random and re-grades their settled answers. A failed audit burns 50% of the bond, 1,500,000 POA. A junk identity expects to lose 120,000 POA per epoch, over twice the 45,000 POA floor payout, so 1,000 junk fakes lose 120 million each epoch after locking 3 billion. Passing takes real work in every identity, so cost grows linearly with n. Pooling coins cannot help. A marble of fresh keys, a signal of bought wallets or a gale of idle accounts all face it.
